title: Chaotic Haunted Kitchen
description: A surreal, messy kitchen scene with green cabinets, a black sink, and a bright yellow refrigerator covered in skull stickers and drawings. The floor is littered with spilled food, broken pizza boxes, a cracked mug, a fishbowl with a red fish, and a small black creature, while a large stained-glass window depicts a ghost holding balloons.
prompt: A dark and chaotic kitchen interior with green wooden cabinets and a black sink under a large stained-glass window showing a white ghost holding red and purple balloons. A bright yellow refrigerator is covered in skull stickers and drawings with flies buzzing around it. The white floor is messy with spilled food, a broken mug, pizza boxes, a fishbowl containing a red fish and purple liquid, and a small black spider-like creature. Dramatic lighting with rays beaming through the window, in a detailed surreal cartoon style.
